$comment: Every package, or package subpath, the workspace declares or imports, with its category and its seam: the repository globs of the files that may import it (decisions 51, 52 and 58). A core entry is imported anywhere; every other entry only inside its seam, type-only imports included unless "types" is "anywhere", and an empty seam means no file may import it yet. The most specific entry wins (next/navigation before next), and every Node builtin is the entry node:*. A test also imports what the seam of the unit it tests admits, and a testInfrastructure file any registered package. local/dependency-seam enforces it on apps/* and packages/*, and local/wrapped-import the names a wrapper owns of two core packages (react-native, expo-router); pnpm verify:dependency-seams holds it to every package.json and file. Every entry names its owner: the capability of template.manifest.json whose prune removes its package, which takes the entry and its seam with it, or core; pnpm verify:manifest:coverage holds each owner to the manifest (docs/manifest.md). openMigrations lists the migrations still in progress, each { id, note }: an entry of eslint-dependency-seam-allowlist.json counts only while its migration is the id of one, and an open migration no entry names is stale, closed by removing it. A registry without the field declares none, and this one declares none, so the allowlist stays empty. See docs/code-standards.md section 23.

packages.name: expo-router
packages.note: Its hooks (every use name) and its router object are imported only under an app's src/lib/routing/, which local/wrapped-import holds by the names imported; its layout components (Stack, Tabs, Slot, Redirect, Link) and its types stay direct. The mobile app calls no hook yet, so its lib/routing holds no module.

packages.name: next
packages.note: next/cache, next/navigation and next/image are narrowed by entries of their own.

packages.name: react-native
packages.note: A primitive a components/ui block is named after (on mobile Text, Modal, Button and StatusBar) is imported only under that block's folder, which local/wrapped-import holds by the names imported, reading the blocks from disk; every other file renders the block. View, ScrollView, Pressable, TextInput and every primitive no block is named after stay direct.

packages.name: next/cache
packages.note: Behind applyCachePolicy of lib/cache, which a 'use cache' function calls with one of the app's CacheLifeEnum profiles and its tags; its tests mock @/lib/cache.

packages.name: next/navigation
packages.note: Behind useAppRouter of lib/routing, whose IAppRouter (push, replace, refresh) is the app's own; every other test mocks @/lib/routing through createRoutingDouble of src/test/routing.helper.ts.

packages.name: next-intl
packages.note: Behind IAppTranslator of @app/i18n, which apps/web/src/lib/i18n/ implements. Two framework files name it as well: the request config, whose getRequestConfig call next-intl loads by path, and the Next config, which loads the plugin.

packages.name: react-i18next
packages.note: Behind IAppTranslator of @app/i18n, which apps/mobile/src/lib/i18n/ implements.

packages.name: i18next
packages.note: The instance apps/mobile/src/lib/i18n/i18n.config.ts starts; blocks reach it through useAppTranslator.

packages.name: i18next-icu
packages.note: The ICU format of the shared catalogs, plugged in by apps/mobile/src/lib/i18n/i18n.config.ts.

packages.name: @formatjs/intl-pluralrules
packages.note: Hermes's missing plural rules, polyfilled by apps/mobile/src/lib/i18n/intlPolyfill.config.ts before i18next starts.

packages.name: expo-localization
packages.note: The device language the first start falls back to, read by apps/mobile/src/lib/i18n/i18n.config.ts.

packages.name: @tanstack/react-query
packages.note: Behind useAppQuery, useAppMutation, useInvalidateAppQuery and AppQueryProvider, whose option and result types are the project's own; tests render through createQueryWrapper of src/test/query.helper.tsx. The seam stays the folder: the tests of the key factories reach the client too.

packages.name: zustand
packages.note: Behind createAppStore: every store under src/stores is created through it, which gives the store its useShallow and its optional persistence; each store declares its own named selectors.

packages.name: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
packages.note: Behind IKeyValueStoragePort of @app/core: the theme and language configs and every persisted store keep their values on the device through keyValueStorage of lib/storage.

packages.name: expo-splash-screen
packages.note: Behind holdSplashScreen and hideSplashScreen: the root layout holds the splash as it loads, and useAppBootstrap hides it once the fonts settle.

packages.name: @expo-google-fonts/inter
packages.note: Behind useAppBootstrap: APP_FONTS names every face the app renders its text in, which the hook loads before the root layout renders a route.

packages.name: @expo-google-fonts/montserrat
packages.note: Behind useAppBootstrap: APP_FONTS names its faces, and the hook loads them through its useFonts.

packages.name: nativewind
packages.note: The class dialect is core (decision 58); the package itself is imported by lib/theme and the config files.

packages.name: next/image
packages.note: Behind the Image block, whose props are its own; every other block renders it, and a test mocks it, never next/image.

packages.name: tailwind-variants
packages.note: The one value-import site of tv (F30): every other file builds its variants with the shared tv.

packages.name: tailwind-merge
packages.note: The peer tailwind-variants runs on every call; the shared tv configures it.

packages.name: react-error-boundary
packages.note: Behind the AsyncBoundary block, whose fallback takes the block's own IAsyncBoundaryFallbackProps, so only its component file names the library.

packages.name: expo-linear-gradient
packages.note: Behind the Gradient block, whose props are its own; every other block paints a gradient by rendering it.

packages.name: react-native-safe-area-context
packages.note: The root's provider is AppSafeAreaProvider of lib/bootstrap, and the AuthShell block reads its insets.

packages.name: expo-status-bar
packages.note: Behind the StatusBar block, whose StatusBarStyleType the root layout and lib/theme name instead of the library's style type.

packages.name: @sentry/nextjs
packages.note: An optional capability (decision 53): its adapter and the framework config files.

packages.name: @sentry/react-native
packages.note: An optional capability (decision 53).

packages.name: posthog-js
packages.note: The default observability adapter (F.7).

packages.name: posthog-react-native
packages.note: The default observability adapter (F.7).

packages.name: expo-file-system
packages.note: Removes the files posthog-react-native keeps in the document directory under granted, at every opt-in launch (F54); nothing else reads or writes the file system.

packages.name: @supabase/supabase-js
packages.note: Its client leaves the package as the opaque BackendClientType, which only packages/supabase/src/backendClient.adapter.ts turns back into the SDK client.

packages.name: @supabase/ssr
packages.note: The SSR client leaves the package as the opaque BackendClientType, as the browser client does.

packages.name: @app/supabase
packages.note: Each app's lib/supabase adapters: the client, typed BackendClientType, and the auth gateway the app's auth provider receives.

packages.name: node:*
packages.note: Every Node builtin, with or without the node: scheme: tests, configs and tooling scripts run on Node, the apps do not.

packages.name: @app/tooling
packages.note: The shared test and process scripts (decision 46).

packages.name: @testing-library/react
packages.note: Tests render through the local test.helper, which re-exports it; no-restricted-imports keeps that path.

packages.name: tailwindcss
packages.note: The CSS compiler: the web loads it from CSS and PostCSS, never from source, and a test may compile with it. The class dialect is core (decision 58).

packages.name: @next/eslint-plugin-next
packages.note: The root eslint.config.mjs imports it on every run and applies its rules to each app that declares next, so the root declares it and a prune of web-next keeps it.

packages.name: expo-system-ui
packages.note: Applies apps/mobile/app.json's userInterfaceStyle on Android, where Expo needs it installed; no file imports it.
